manifest.tagline: Semantic intake pipeline and intent formation center — decomposes all prompts into typed WordKeyField graphs, resolves CFPC intent/knowledge gaps, routes to domain micronauts via gyro_abi scoring, and logs the full interaction chain via Pattern.Log.dll. GREETING-µ is not a salutation handler — it is the entry point through which all natural-language turns pass before XCFE routing.

api.note: No standalone HTTP server — atomic keys resolve via native driver layer. greeting.decompose runs for ALL inputs before any other key. greeting.route is proposal_only and xcfe_required. greeting.log is append-only via Pattern.Log.dll.

atomic_keys.description: Pop-phase prompt decomposition. Runs for EVERY input. Produces kuhul.word-key-field.v1 payload. Logs entry to Pattern.Log.dll. Three-stage lookup pipeline: STAGE-1 words.manifest.json (surface token → expansions) → STAGE-2 keys.micronaut.json (⟁KEY → lane/authority/pi_routing_weight/routing_entropy) → STAGE-3 WDT (⟁KEY → domain/pi_radius/excludes). Each stage is best-effort: missing manifest or WDT yields null fields, not an error. TOKENIZE: offset-anchor all tokens. POS_HINT rules (priority order, Stage-1): (1) social — intent:salutation or greeting alias chain; (2) code_token — intent:debugging/intent:code_generation in words.manifest OR ⟁KEY matches lane:CODE-µ in keys.micronaut.json; (3) operator — control:* entry in words.manifest; (4) question_word — who/what/when/where/why/how or ELIZA-1:QUESTION op; (5) anaphor — it/this/that/they/them/those/here/there; (6) noun/verb — Book(SUBJECT)/Book(PREDICATE) or fallback POS inference; (7) unknown. GRAM EXTRACTION: 1–4 token spans. CORPUS_PROVENANCE rules (priority order, Stage-1 + Stage-2): (1) aiml — gram matches triple-form dispatch prefix (KEYWORD:/keyword:/@keyword → named micronaut); (2) code_corpus — intent:debugging/intent:code_generation in words.manifest or gram's first token maps to lane:CODE-µ; (3) eliza — gram has ELIZA-1:* operator ref after alias expansion; (4) cfpc — gram matches cfpc-wildcards.gml or cfpc-questions.gml (listed in keys.micronaut.json ⟁POP:FIELD_CONTEXT); (5) none. KEY ASSIGNMENT: derive ⟁KEY per gram; Stage-2 lookup adds lane + key_authority; lane:CODE-µ forces key_authority=XCFE_required; lane:KUHUL-PI adds pi_routing_weight + routing_entropy. EDGE CONSTRUCTION: heuristic/symbolic edges from gram co-occurrence and ELIZA-1 op pairs; Stage-3 WDT associated[] → evidence_type=symbolic wdt_source=associated edges; WDT excludes[] → silently prune any edge where one key's wdt_excludes contains the other key's domain. ANAPHORIC TAGGING: tokens with pos_hint=anaphor that do not resolve → unresolved[reason=anaphoric_reference]. CODE SIGNAL DETECTION: any token with pos_hint=code_token or backtick/indented-block pattern in source_text → intent_candidate CODE_REQUEST (source=code_signal). CONDITIONAL ENTRIES: words.manifest entries with {@if/@then/@else} that cannot resolve at decompose time → bindings.context_refs[resolves_to=unresolved]. Stage-3 WDT: domain + pi_radius (depth_prior_is_calibrated_confidence: false always); WDT unavailable → domain/pi_radius null for all keys.
atomic_keys.log: Pattern.Log.dll — appends decompose entry with source_hash, token_count, gram_count, key_count

atomic_keys.description: Yax/Sek-phase routing decision — takes the WordKeyField (with gap_type from cfpc_gap_classify and intent_candidates from intent_graph_traverse) and emits a typed routing proposal. When KUHUL-PI lane keys are present, uses float32 pi_routing_weight values (formula: 1.0 - hub_cost, Sek-phase, kernel: pi-routing-weight.cl) to rank target micronauts; NaN/Inf pi_routing_weight treated as null and excluded from ranking. Respects gyro_track_map: GREETING_ONLY → ELIZA-µ (no escalation), CODE_REQUEST → CODE-µ → ADVISOR-µ → UNDERSTAND-µ → LEARN-µ chain, KNOWLEDGE_QUERY → INFER-µ → REASON-µ, RELATIONSHIP_QUERY → REASON-µ → ELIZA-µ, ACTION_REQUEST → ORCH-µ → MEM-µ, TASK_REQUEST → ORCH-µ → PLAN-µ, OPINION_REQUEST → REASON-µ → INFER-µ. Proposal populates WordKeyField.routing. routing_entropy (entropy_norm, Ch'en) must satisfy ENTROPY_BOUNDS before the proposal advances past Ch'en verification — a proposal with routing_entropy outside [0.0, 1.0] is rejected. All proposals xcfe_required; pi_routing_weight is a routing signal only: semantic_authority:false, match_grants_execution:false. Logs to Pattern.Log.dll.
atomic_keys.log: Pattern.Log.dll — appends route entry with source_hash, primary_target, escalation_path, gap_type

atomic_keys.description: Append-only interaction log via Pattern.Log.dll — records micronaut, operation, phase, payload_summary, session_id, source_hash, timestamp. Called explicitly at decompose, intent, cfpc, route, escalate, and each XCFE admission transition. Callers supply the entry; Pattern.Log.dll handles persistence and rotation.

Pop-phase quick key response — selects phase-keyed template from greeting-bank.json using {cue}, {greeting}, {last}, {turns}, {lingo_count}, {blend} placeholders. GREETING_ONLY intent resolves here and suppresses escalation. Only fires when gap_type == Resolved and routing.primary_target == ELIZA-µ.

Wo-phase intent-graph traversal on the WordKeyField — walks field_member edges from detected greeting context using keys[] and edges[] from the WordKeyField rather than the raw string; unfolds bigram candidates; instantiates wildcard patterns; returns scored intent candidates ranked by field coverage and bigram depth (max_depth 4, cycle_policy: active_path_detection). Populates WordKeyField.intent_candidates.
atomic_keys.note: Consumes WordKeyField produced by greeting.decompose — does NOT re-tokenize the raw string.

atomic_keys.description: Yax-phase CFPC gap classification — bitmap classify produces one of: Resolved, IntentGap, QueryGap, KnowledgeGapNoKeys, KnowledgeGapNoValues. Sets WordKeyField.gap_type. Resolved suppresses escalation and keeps the turn with ELIZA-µ. Any gap type triggers greeting.route. Logs classification to Pattern.Log.dll.

Sek-phase XCFE routing proposal emission — fires when greeting.route has produced a non-null primary_target and XCFE has admitted the proposal. Sends the admitted WordKeyField to the primary_target micronaut. Logs the final dispatch to Pattern.Log.dll.

Xul-phase lingo absorption — absorb_lingo_cues from WordKeyField tokens, archive_greeting_ngrams to gram store, blend adapted lingo into future greeting.bank templates via {lingo_count} and {blend} placeholders.

Pop-phase diagnostics — reports intent-graph traversal status, greeting-bank template coverage (8 phases), gyro_abi dimension map availability, CFPC-µ routing status, Pattern.Log.dll write status, WordKeyField schema version.

word_domain_tree_ref_note: Set to data/word-domain-tree.json once a WDT instance is built. greeting.decompose uses the WDT for ⟁KEY domain lookup, pi_radius inheritance, and excludes-based edge pruning.

xcfe.note: greeting.route emits a routing proposal into WordKeyField.routing. XCFE must set routing.xcfe_status=admitted before greeting.escalate fires. intent-graph.gml and WordKeyField edges are data_only; graph membership and edge confidence are not execution authority.

intent_templates.pattern: what is the connection between * and *

CODE_REQUEST.note: triggered by code_signal in tokens pos_hint or backtick/indent block detection in source_text

learning.note: greeting-µ archives lingo ngrams and style profiles via gramWrite. Pattern.Log.dll writes are append-only. Pattern evolution authority belongs to LEARN-µ.

driver_roles.Micronaut.Core.dll: tokenize raw prompt, offset-anchor tokens, n-gram span extraction (1–4), gram store management
driver_roles.CFPC.Patterns.dll: CFPC gap classification (bitmap classify: Resolved/IntentGap/QueryGap/KnowledgeGapNoKeys/KnowledgeGapNoValues), edge construction from intent-graph.gml, symbolic edge evidence
driver_roles.Field.Patterns.dll: Stage-1 words.manifest.json lookup (pos_hint derivation, corpus_provenance derivation, ELIZA-1 op → graph_relation mapping, intent tag extraction); Stage-2 keys.micronaut.json lookup (⟁KEY → lane assignment, key_authority, pi_routing_weight, routing_entropy; lane:CODE-µ → forces XCFE_required); Stage-3 WDT domain lookup (keys[].domain, pi_radius inheritance with depth_prior_is_calibrated_confidence:false, WDT associated[] → symbolic edges with wdt_source=associated, WDT excludes[] → silent edge pruning); field-category routing via eliza-bias.gml; graph_relation labelling
driver_roles.Micronaut.Patterns.dll: code_signal detection (code_token pos_hint, backtick/indent block patterns), anaphoric reference tagging, unresolved set assembly, wildcard capture binding
driver_roles.Pattern.Log.dll: append-only interaction log — records every significant pipeline transition (decompose, intent, cfpc, route, escalate, xcfe_admission) with source_hash correlation, microsecond timestamps, and payload summaries
